# Halal Meat Depot — full catalogue

> Halal Meat Depot is a Greenacre, Sydney-based halal meat supplier established in 2021, offering beef, lamb, goat, chicken, camel, duck, kangaroo and water buffalo certified halal by Halal Control Australia. Halal Meat Depot delivers Australia-wide and specialises in bulk packs, whole carcasses and wholesale cartons for households, restaurants and caterers at depot prices.

## Facts

- Legal entity: AUSBD HALAL FOODS PTY LTD (ABN 27 093 995 629), 43 Banksia Rd, Greenacre NSW 2190
- Halal certification: Halal Control Australia, certificate No. HSS 027843, valid until 2 April 2027 — https://halalmeatdepot.com.au/halal-certification/
- Delivery only (no pickup), Australia-wide. Minimum order $250; free delivery over $500, otherwise $25.
- Payment: PayID, bank transfer or crypto (10% off the meat total with crypto). Phone/WhatsApp 0489 989 442.
- Returns: no change-of-mind returns on fresh meat; problems reported within 48 hours are replaced or refunded — https://halalmeatdepot.com.au/refund/

## Beef — https://halalmeatdepot.com.au/shop/halal-beef/

Halal beef for butchers, restaurants, caterers and families — from whole, half and quarter carcasses to premium steaks, Angus and Wagyu, roasts, slow-cook cuts, mince, veal and sausages, all at wholesale prices and certified halal by Halal Control Australia.

### Whole Beef

- URL: https://halalmeatdepot.com.au/product/whole-beef/
- Pack: approx. 260kg carcass (hook weight) — $3377.40 (about $12.99/kg)
- A whole beef carcass cut to your instructions — the lowest per-kilo price on beef we offer.
- A whole beef carcass is every cut from one animal in a single order: both forequarters for curries, mince and brisket, and both hindquarters for the steaks and roasts. Butchers, community kitchens and extended families use a whole beef to fill freezers for months at a time.
- Cooking: Ideal for butchers, restaurants and large community events. Tell us how you want it broken down — primals, steaks, mince, diced and bones — in the order notes. Final weight varies by animal.

### Half Beef

- URL: https://halalmeatdepot.com.au/product/half-beef/
- Pack: approx. 130kg side (hook weight) — $1818.70 (about $13.99/kg)
- A half beef (one side) cut to your instructions for restaurants, butchers and big families.
- A half beef is one side of the carcass, split down the spine, so you receive one of every primal — chuck, rib, brisket, loin, rump and leg. It is the usual choice for a family sharing an order or a restaurant that wants a balanced mix of premium and everyday cuts.
- Cooking: A side gives you the full spread of cuts — roasts, steaks, mince, diced and soup bones. Add your cutting instructions in the order notes; final weight varies by animal.

### Beef Hindquarter

- URL: https://halalmeatdepot.com.au/product/beef-hindquarter/
- Pack: approx. 60kg quarter (hook weight) — $899.40 (about $14.99/kg)
- A beef hindquarter — the rump, loin and leg, home of the premium steaks.
- The hindquarter is the back section of the side, from the loin to the leg. It carries the striploin, eye fillet, rump and the silverside and topside, which is why it holds most of the grilling steaks and lean roasts on the animal.
- Cooking: The hindquarter carries the striploin, eye fillet, rump and topside. Choose steaks, roasts or a mix and tell us in the order notes.

### Beef Forequarter

- URL: https://halalmeatdepot.com.au/product/beef-forequarter/
- Pack: approx. 60kg quarter (hook weight) — $839.40 (about $13.99/kg)
- A beef forequarter — chuck, blade, brisket and rib for slow cooking, mince and curries.
- The forequarter is the front section of the side: chuck, blade, rib, brisket and shin. These are hard-working muscles with more connective tissue and flavour, making the forequarter the natural choice for curries, mince, stews and slow-cooked brisket.
- Cooking: The forequarter is the most economical way to buy beef in bulk for curry houses and kebab shops. Have it broken into diced, mince, brisket and bone-in curry cuts.

### Beef Whole Rear Half

- URL: https://halalmeatdepot.com.au/product/beef-whole-rear-half/
- Pack: approx. 120kg (both hindquarters, hook weight) — $1738.80 (about $14.49/kg)
- Both beef hindquarters together — every premium loin and leg cut from one animal.
- The rear half joins both hindquarters from the same animal, giving two of each premium cut — two striploins, two eye fillets, two rumps and both legs. Steakhouses buy it to keep their loin and fillet supply consistent from week to week.
- Cooking: The rear half gives restaurants a steady supply of striploin, eye fillet, rump and topside. Specify your steak thickness and roast sizes in the order notes.

### Beef Tomahawk Steaks

- URL: https://halalmeatdepot.com.au/product/beef-tomahawk-steaks/
- Pack: 2 steaks, approx. 2.4kg — $93.60 (about $39.00/kg)
- Thick-cut tomahawk rib eye steaks with the long rib bone — a showpiece for the grill.
- A tomahawk is a rib eye steak cut with the full rib bone left long and frenched clean. The eye of the rib is generously marbled, and the long bone makes it the steak people photograph before they eat it.
- Cooking: Each tomahawk weighs around 1.2kg and feeds two to three people. Reverse-sear it: cook gently until 50°C in the centre, then finish over very high heat for the crust.

### Beef Scotch Fillet Steaks

- URL: https://halalmeatdepot.com.au/product/scotch-fillet-ribeye-steaks/
- Pack: 2kg pack — $92.98 (about $46.49/kg)
- Well-marbled boneless scotch fillet steaks for the grill and pan.
- Scotch fillet, known as ribeye elsewhere, is cut from the boneless rib section between the chuck and the striploin. Fine marbling runs through the eye of the meat, so it bastes itself as it cooks and stays juicy past medium.
- Cooking: Scotch fillet stays juicy at medium and beyond thanks to its marbling. Sear hard, rest five minutes and slice against the grain.

### Beef Porterhouse Steaks

- URL: https://halalmeatdepot.com.au/product/sirloin-steak-beef-porterhouse/
- Pack: 2kg pack — $71.98 (about $35.99/kg)
- Classic porterhouse steaks with a fat cap for flavour.
- Porterhouse is the Australian name for the sirloin steak cut from the striploin, the muscle that runs along the back. It has a fine grain, a firm, satisfying bite and a strip of fat along one edge that adds flavour as it renders.
- Cooking: Score the fat cap, season well and grill to medium-rare. A dependable steak for restaurants and family barbecues alike.

### Beef Eye Fillet Steaks

- URL: https://halalmeatdepot.com.au/product/beef-eye-fillet-steaks/
- Pack: 2kg pack — $109.98 (about $54.99/kg)
- Tender eye fillet steaks, trimmed and portioned.
- Eye fillet, also called tenderloin, sits under the backbone and does almost no work, which is why it is the most tender steak on the animal. It is lean with a soft, buttery texture, so it suits quick, hot cooking and simple seasoning.
- Cooking: The most tender steak on the animal. Two to three minutes a side in a very hot pan, then rest before serving.

### Beef T-Bone Steaks

- URL: https://halalmeatdepot.com.au/product/beef-steak-t-bone/
- Pack: 2kg pack — $71.98 (about $35.99/kg)
- T-bone steaks — sirloin and tenderloin on one bone.
- A T-bone is cut across the short loin so a T-shaped bone separates two muscles: the porterhouse on one side and a smaller piece of eye fillet on the other. You get the bite of a sirloin and the tenderness of a fillet in one steak.
- Cooking: Keep the fillet side away from the hottest part of the grill so both sides finish together.

### Beef Rump Steaks

- URL: https://halalmeatdepot.com.au/product/rump-beef-steaks/
- Pack: 2kg pack — $57.98 (about $28.99/kg)
- Flavourful rump steaks for grilling, kebabs and steak sandwiches.
- Rump steaks are cut from the hip, where several muscles meet, so a rump carries more beefy flavour and a little more chew than loin steaks. It is the steak of choice for kebab grills and steak sandwiches because it holds its texture when sliced.
- Cooking: Rump has more bite and beefy flavour than loin cuts. Marinate briefly, grill hot and slice thinly.

### Beef Cattleman's Cutlet

- URL: https://halalmeatdepot.com.au/product/beef-cattleman-s-cutlet/
- Pack: 2 cutlets, approx. 3.2kg — $196.77 (about $61.49/kg)
- Thick bone-in rib cutlets — a striking steak for sharing.
- A cattleman's cutlet is a thick, bone-in rib eye — the same muscle as scotch fillet, left on a shortened rib bone. The bone shields the meat during cooking and adds flavour, which suits slow-then-hot cooking methods.
- Cooking: Reverse-sear: cook gently until 50°C in the centre, then finish over high heat. Carve off the bone to serve.

### Dry-Aged Cattleman's Cutlet

- URL: https://halalmeatdepot.com.au/product/dry-aged-cattleman-s-cutlet/
- Pack: 2 cutlets, approx. 3kg — $212.97 (about $70.99/kg)
- Dry-aged bone-in rib cutlets with a deeper, nutty flavour.
- These bone-in rib cutlets are dry-aged: hung uncovered under controlled refrigeration so moisture evaporates and natural enzymes tenderise the meat. The result is a denser texture and a savoury, nutty depth that fresh steak does not have.
- Cooking: Dry-ageing concentrates flavour and tenderises the meat. Cook to medium-rare and rest well.

### Beef Fiorentina Steak

- URL: https://halalmeatdepot.com.au/product/beef-fiorentina-steak/
- Pack: 2 steaks, approx. 2.4kg — $115.18 (about $47.99/kg)
- Thick-cut Florentine-style T-bone for sharing.
- Fiorentina is the Tuscan way of cutting the short loin: a very thick T-bone with both the sirloin and the fillet attached. It is cut to be cooked whole over coals and carved at the table for two or more people.
- Cooking: Cook over hot coals, about five minutes a side, stand it on the bone to finish, then rest and slice.

### Dry-Aged Fiorentina Steak

- URL: https://halalmeatdepot.com.au/product/dry-aged-fiorentina-steak/
- Pack: 2 steaks, approx. 2.4kg — $129.58 (about $53.99/kg)
- Dry-aged Florentine-style T-bone with intense flavour.
- A dry-aged Fiorentina combines the thick Tuscan T-bone cut with time in a dry-ageing room. Ageing concentrates the beef flavour and firms the texture, so the sirloin and fillet sides both develop a deeper, richer taste.
- Cooking: Dry-aged for a richer crust and deeper flavour. Grill hot, rest well and carve both sides off the bone.

### Beef New York Strip Bone-in

- URL: https://halalmeatdepot.com.au/product/beef-new-york-steak-bone-in/
- Pack: 2kg pack — $84.98 (about $42.49/kg)
- Bone-in New York strip steaks — the sirloin cooked on the bone.
- The New York strip is the striploin steak — the same muscle as porterhouse — cut with the bone left on. Cooking on the bone slows the heat into the meat beside it, keeping that edge of the steak juicier.
- Cooking: The bone protects the meat and adds flavour. Grill to medium-rare over high heat.

### Dry-Aged New York Strip Bone-in

- URL: https://halalmeatdepot.com.au/product/dry-aged-beef-online-new-york-strip/
- Pack: 2kg pack — $90.98 (about $45.49/kg)
- Dry-aged bone-in New York strip for steak lovers.
- This bone-in New York strip has been dry-aged before cutting, which removes moisture and lets natural enzymes work on the muscle. Expect a firmer bite, a darker crust when seared and a concentrated, slightly nutty beef flavour.
- Cooking: Dry-ageing gives a firmer texture and nutty depth. Season simply with salt and cook hot.

- A three-rib Angus standing rib roast (MB3–4+) for celebrations.
- A standing rib roast is the rib section left on the bone, cut here with three ribs from marble score 3 to 4 plus Angus. Roasting it upright on its bones keeps the meat moist and makes for an impressive carving joint.
- Cooking: Roast at 220°C for 20 minutes, then 160°C until 52°C inside for medium-rare. Rest 20 minutes and carve between the bones.
